text: Android list rows: show quantity/note; fix hardcoded red; assorted row/label polish

Landmine for the Color.Red -> colorScheme.error change: ListScreenTest (A7)
asserts exactly assertEquals(Color.Red, checkedStyle.color) and
assertNotEquals(Color.Red, uncheckedStyle.color) (lines ~71/73), reading the
resolved TextStyle via the GetTextLayoutResult semantics action. The literal
Color.Red was a deliberate A7 choice to match Notes' "red strike-through"
independent of theme; switching to a theme color is fine but that assertion must
change — a theme color also can't be asserted as a fixed literal, so assert
textDecoration + that the checked row's color differs from the unchecked row
instead.
